name: mediamake
description: Drive Mediamake from Claude: projects and timelines, presets, media, transcription, generation workers, agents and renders.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Mediamake app with a Mediamake API key. Read saved projects and timelines (tagged as tree, flat or legacy format), browse presets and their input schemas, build timelines, upload and search media, transcribe songs into timed captions, run generation workers (video, image, audio) and agents, and render on AWS Lambda.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Mediamake projects the API key can see (owned or shared).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project and a page of its timelines (newest first).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new Mediamake project.

tools.name: get_brand_kit
tools.description: Read a project's brand kit: colours, fonts, guide and every uploaded asset.

tools.name: upload_brand_kit
tools.description: Upload a pack-brand-kit folder from this computer to a project.

tools.name: update_brand_kit
tools.description: Change a project's brand kit fields.

tools.name: list_timelines
tools.description: List timelines (id, name, dates).

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Read a saved timeline.

tools.name: survey_timelines
tools.description: Read many timelines at once and aggregate them: how many are in each format, which presets each format uses and how often, and canvas configs.

tools.name: create_timeline
tools.description: Create a timeline in a project.

tools.name: update_timeline
tools.description: Replace fields of a timeline.

tools.name: list_legacy_timelines
tools.description: List saved timelines in the oldest, deprecated format (the presetData collection).

tools.name: get_legacy_timeline
tools.description: Read one legacy presetData timeline.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List presets (the building blocks of a timeline).

tools.name: get_preset
tools.description: Get a preset's metadata (including defaultInputParams) and its input JSON schema (presetParams).

tools.name: add_preset_to_timeline
tools.description: Append a preset instance to a timeline, the way the editor's Add button does at the top level: inputs start from the preset's defaultInputParams, your presetInputData is merged on top, and the track gets a unique trackName.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List files in the Mediamake media library, newest first, with filters.

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Semantic search over the analysed media library (descriptions, keywords, art style, colours).

tools.name: get_media
tools.description: Get one media library entry with all its metadata.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Put a file into Mediamake storage and the media library, and return its public URL.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a song or voice track into timed captions (lines with word timings) and save it in the Mediamake transcription library.

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.description: List saved transcriptions, newest first.

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Get one transcription's captions.

tools.name: list_workers
tools.description: List Mediamake generation workers: video (google-veo, kling-ai, runway, luma, pika, minimax, wan, heygen, d-id, sync-so), image (google-nanobanana, flux, ideogram, stability, magnific), audio (elevenlabs tts/sfx/voice clone, udio, stable audio), ffmpeg compose and subtitle burn, transcriber and more.

tools.name: get_worker_schema
tools.description: JSON schema of a worker's input.

tools.name: run_worker
tools.description: Start a worker job (generation costs credits on the provider).

tools.name: get_worker_job
tools.description: Status and output of a worker job.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List Mediamake AI agents (preset writing, prompting, Midjourney, metadata, summarise, research, audio analysis…).

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Call a Mediamake agent by its path (from list_agents) and return its response.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render a Remotion composition from inputProps on AWS Lambda (default) or on the machine running the Mediamake app (target "local", dev server only).

tools.name: render_presets
tools.description: Render a list of preset instances on Lambda: the server runs each preset in order (a full/scene preset first, then tracks and effects) and renders the result.

tools.name: render_status
tools.description: Progress of a Lambda render; returns the output URL once done.

tools.name: list_renders
tools.description: Render history, newest first (without inputProps).

tools.name: get_render_input_props
tools.description: The exact inputProps a past render used (the compiled composition JSON).

api_url.title: Mediamake URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your Mediamake app, e.g. https://your-mediamake-host or http://localhost:3000

api_key.title: Mediamake API key
api_key.description: From Mediamake Settings, API keys. Leave empty only for a local dev server with DEV_API_KEY set.
